During an interaction at the University of Chicago, Congress leader Rahul Gandhi was asked by a Pakistani student whether India and Pakistan could resume dialogue and work together. Rahul said talks could become possible only when Pakistan stops supporting terrorism. He also criticised the Modi government's foreign policy, saying India has become a "side player" in global affairs. Here's what he said about Pakistan, Iran, Israel and India's role in the world.
